# VariantDraft

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class VariantDraft
```

An editable variant: identity + weight + its pixels, in one or both of the two forms a variant can be authored in.

## Remarks

A variant carries a grayscale [`VariantDraft.Map`](Nfty.Core.Editing.VariantDraft.md#p-map) always, and a full-color [`VariantDraft.Color`](Nfty.Core.Editing.VariantDraft.md#p-color) once it has been painted or imported in color mode. Which one is authoritative is decided by the owning [`IngredientDraft.Kind`](Nfty.Core.Editing.IngredientDraft.md#p-kind) and never by which happens to be non-null: a Custom ingredient exports its [`VariantDraft.Color`](Nfty.Core.Editing.VariantDraft.md#p-color), everything else exports its [`VariantDraft.Map`](Nfty.Core.Editing.VariantDraft.md#p-map).

Both are kept rather than one replacing the other because that is precisely what the non-destructive save needs. Painting a Dynamic layer in color leaves its value-map untouched — so the original ingredient stays byte-identical on disk — while the color map becomes a new Custom ingredient beside it.

## Methods

### EnsureColor() { #m-ensurecolor }

```csharp
public ColorMap EnsureColor();
```

The variant's color pixels, widening its value-map on first use so entering color mode shows the drawing that is already there rather than a blank canvas. Idempotent: once a color map exists it is returned untouched, so re-entering color mode never discards paint.

**Returns.** This variant's color map.
